notes.title: Soul Passage Demo is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43371052/ac3b6f27623d43499d91cbd47018835fd7bb444b.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone I'm Emrah Özbay a Solo Developer of Soul Passage and I just released my very first demo. The demo is a small taste of what's to come in the full game, which will be launching in early 2025.

Those who try out the demo will get a glimpse of the game's unique art style and basic mechanics. The demo includes a simple section of the game without features like planet travel, progress, crafting, or boss fights. However, this is just the beginning - a bigger demo is planned for the Steam Next Fest summer edition, where players will get to meet a boss and explore more of the Soul Universe.

Soul Passage is the story of a nameless warrior who has lost his family and village. He makes a deal with the Heartless Soul Keeper to bring his people back to life or leave their souls to go to heaven. In exchange, the Soul Keeper tasks him with gathering the souls of his enemies and passing them through the Soul Passage.

To try out the demo, head over to the Steam page and download it for free. And don't forget to mark your calendar for March 1st - [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ozbayemrah/soul-passage-adventure-metroidvania-in-different-planets]the launch of the Soul Passage Kickstarter campaign[/url]. Every little bit of support counts, so let's help make this project a reality.

Don't Forget to WISHLIST Soul Passage on Steam
